description:
Hi, 
 This is Raju. I am Recruiter at Randstad Technologies and I am reaching out in regards to your background. I have an exciting opportunity
  *Candidates MUST be able to work on W2 to qualify for this role.* 
 ​ 
 
 
 Job Title : Application Developer / Lead  
 Duration: 6 Months 
 Position Type: Contract to Prem 
 Location: PLANO, TX  
 Job description: 
 Summary: 
Experienced C# server side developer with solid database skills and experience developing intranet applications with a .Net environment. Must have exposure to developing within a professional intranet environment leveraging identity-based authentication.   Experience with Agile methodologies and Test driven development.
5+ years’ experience in an IT Application development environment. 3+ years’ C# .NET experience (server side)

 Experienced in leveraging Technical Analysis documentation to meet coding/testing responsibilities.

 Experienced or well-versed in Scrum/Agile methodologies

 Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills

 Hands-on development.

 Please have a look at the below job requirement and reply back to me with your latest word format resume ASAP. Do let me know the best contact number to reach you.  

 Note : If you feel this job description does not suit your profile then kindly let me know your preferred job roles so that I can be in touch with you with similar jobs and you can refer me a suitable person for this job as well. Hope to hear from you soon.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
